dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: The posterior edge of the dark band exhibits a deep V-shape indentation where the white fur of the back extends forward towards the neck.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band is significantly wider at the lateral flanks, narrowing to approximately one-third of its lateral thickness at the dorsal midline.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are separated by a wide expanse of white fur, approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior boundaries of the ears are perfectly rounded and semicircular with no evidence of flattening.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive brownish-tan staining or discoloration on the white fur of the lower back and rump regions.
